metadata.title: That 1 kill that happened while I was definitely NOT aiming lol Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get lucky or did the enemy uninstall mid-fight?
My aim clocked in for like 0.2 seconds and still pulled this off.
